versions.changelog:
Version v1.1.0 is a feature and documentation update.

- Adds "tags" metadata for improved discoverability.
- Updates and expands usage scenarios for practical, real-world examples.
- Includes a detailed WeChat/mobile storage cleanup scenario in Chinese.
- Increments versioning to v1.1.0 to reflect enhancements.
- No functional logic changes to privacy-first workflow.
Security cleanup: removed mock scanning claims; skill now only accepts user-supplied information. Explicitly states no device/cloud/password scanning.

No changes detected in this version.

- Version and content remain the same compared to the previous release.
- No files were modified.

Digital Life Organizer 0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Provides digital asset inventory, file organization, subscription management, and password security audit.
- Supports flexible actions via schema-driven API, covering full or partial audits.
- Outputs structured, actionable reports and organization/improvement plans.
- Designed to help users truly take control of digital life and reduce digital anxiety.
